HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

2. Which statement about Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence.
   D. Explain Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. Which statement about Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   C. Say Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.

   D. Treat Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa.

8. Which statement about Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   C. Say Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   A. Say Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period never happens in Kenya.

   B. Ignore prices in shops

----
